test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The US ______ building was built in the year 1800.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"capitol"** refers to a building where a legislative assembly meets. (विधानसभा भवन)

 
 
• **Example: **The US Capitol building was built in the year 1800.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to fill in the blank is **'capitol'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Capital **(राजधानी): The city that serves as the seat of government.

 
 
• **Example:** London is the capital of the United Kingdom.
 
 
 
• **Cannibal **(आदमीखोर): A person who eats the flesh of other human beings.
 
 
• **Example: **There are legends of cannibals living in the remote regions of the world.
 
 
 
• **Captain **(कप्तान): The person in command of a ship, aircraft, or sports team.
 
 
• **Example:** He was appointed as the captain of the cricket team.

The correct answer is: Option 2&
